Job Title: Generative AI Engineer (.NET & AWS)
Experience: 610 Years
Location: Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata
Employment Type: Full-Time




Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Generative AI Engineer with strong expertise in .NET technologies and AWS Cloud to build, deploy, and optimize enterprise-scale AI applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, AI Agents, Amazon Bedrock, and modern .NET development frameworks.

The role involves designing and implementing AI-powered solutions, integrating foundation models, developing cloud-native applications, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative business solutions.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI solutions using enterprise-grade architecture.
Build scalable applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET 6/7/8, and microservices.
Develop and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases and embeddings.
Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) through Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Llama, Mistral, and other foundation models.
Develop AI-powered chatbots, virtual assistants, knowledge management systems, and intelligent automation solutions.
Design and implement AI Agents, prompt engineering frameworks, and function-calling workflows.
Create secure and scalable APIs for AI services and enterprise integrations.
Deploy and manage applications on AWS cloud platforms.
Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and data teams to define AI use cases and technical solutions.
Conduct code reviews, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and optimization.
Ensure compliance with security, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
